top_news.title: Fully-sensorized smart-eyewear platform for on-device Machine Learning
top_news.dek: The ARGO smart eyewear platform uses the STM32N6 microcontroller to run on-device machine learning for real-time obstacle detection.
top_news.brief: ARGO integrates hardware, firmware, and AI to enable local processing on smart glasses. By utilizing the STM32N6's Neural Processing Unit, it runs an optimized YOLOv11 model for urban obstacle recognition, reducing latency and improving privacy compared to cloud-based alternatives.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram of ARGO smart eyewear hardware architecture

top_news.title: Qwen-Image-3.0: Rich Content, Authentic Details, Deep Knowledge
top_news.dek: Alibaba released Qwen-Image-3.0, a foundational image generation model emphasizing realism and complex layout support.
top_news.brief: The third-generation model focuses on 'real' output, supporting up to 4.5k tokens for input. It is designed to handle complex visual structures like storyboards, newspapers, and exam papers with improved authenticity and detail.

top_news.title: Introducing Gemini 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite, and 3.5 Flash Cyber
top_news.dek: Google has released three new Gemini models—3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite, and 3.5 Flash Cyber—optimized for high-efficiency AI agent development.
top_news.brief: The new model lineup focuses on improving token efficiency, reducing latency, and increasing reliability for production-grade AI agents. These updates are designed to support developers building at scale, emphasizing performance metrics critical for agentic workflows.
top_news.image_alt: Graphic showing the branding for Gemini 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite, and 3.5 Flash Cyber.

top_news.title: An AI system helped Pakistani judges clear massive backlogs at $38.50 return per dollar invested
top_news.dek: A field study of 1,559 Pakistani judges found that JudgeGPT increased case resolution by 6.3%, provided users received hands-on training.
top_news.brief: Researchers from ETH Zurich and other institutions tested JudgeGPT, a RAG-based assistant using GPT-4, across 118 courts. The study highlights that AI efficacy in legal settings is highly dependent on user training; without it, performance gains were negligible. The project yielded an estimated $38.50 return per dollar invested.
top_news.image_alt: Conceptual illustration of AI assisting in a legal courtroom setting.

top_news.title: Nativ: Run AI models locally on your Mac
top_news.dek: Nativ is a new macOS application that provides a local chat interface and API server for running AI models using Apple's MLX framework.
top_news.brief: Developed by Prince Canuma, Nativ wraps the MLX-VLM library into a desktop app, offering functionality similar to LM Studio. It allows users to run vision-LLMs locally on Mac hardware, providing both a GUI for interaction and a localhost API for programmatic access.
top_news.image_alt: Screenshot of the Nativ desktop application interface on macOS.
